text.tspan: One pattern, every part labeled. Read it left to right, the way the engine does.
* zero or more, + one or more,
A flag, after the closing slash.
i ignore case, g find all,
Does not: A-123 · AB-12 · AB-12345 · xAB-123
Use a regex to check the SHAPE of a short string. Do not use one to parse HTML, and do not invent your own for email;
type="email" already does it. A pattern with a g flag keeps lastIndex between calls, so reusing one across a loop can skip
matches; make a fresh regex, or use String.matchAll.
